user_query: I'm organizing a movie marathon for my company and we want to include the movie 'Titanic'. Can you help us by retrieving the movie reviews, cast details with their images, and some movie images? It would be great if you could also provide the movie ID.

TaskList.description: Fetch movie reviews using the movie ID obtained from Step 1.
Get cast details and their images using the movie ID obtained from Step 1.
